description: Fetch a Reddit post with its comments. Requires EITHER url OR post_id. IMPORTANT: When using post_id alone, an extra API call is made to fetch the subreddit first (2 calls total). For better efficiency, always provide the subreddit parameter when known (1 call total).

comment_depth.description: Default 3, range (1-10). Override ONLY IF user specifies.

comment_limit.description: Default 20, range (1-500). Change ONLY IF user asks.

max_top_comments.description: Default 5, range (1-20). Change ONLY IF user requests.

subreddit.description: Subreddit name (optional with post_id, but more efficient if provided)

name: get_post_details
